services.name: Summer Camp
services.desc: Our traditional, residential summer camp program is for children and youth ages 8-17. Throughout the week, campers will participate in Bible study, worship, missions exchange, swimming, crafting, high ropes, sports, and more. Cabins and activities are staffed by awesome counselors who have completed training, background checks, and CPR/First Aid certification. The classic camp model offers campers opportunities to build new community within their cabins, grow in self-confidence, and receive encouragement and mentorship from counselors passionate about following Jesus.
